name: Rioja
about: Hot dry summers, genuinely cold winters with occasional snow, harvest in Sep–Oct.
overview: Tempranillo country in the Ebro valley, known for winery architecture — Gehry's titanium Marqués de Riscal, Calatrava's Ysios — as much as the wine.
costOverview: Affordable for a wine region — a pintxos crawl down Calle Laurel costs just a few euros a stop, and even a full winery cellar tour with tasting doesn't reach the prices of Bordeaux or Napa.

specialSeasons.text: La Batalla del Vino in Haro — a town-wide wine fight where participants drench each other in red wine.
Grape harvest is underway, with grape-treading and harvest festivals at many bodegas.
